_note: Sources for the entertainment wire.
This is a feed on the industry, not on its output. Reviews, trailers,
casting, box office weekends, awards and celebrity coverage are refused by
the gate — that is nearly all entertainment coverage, and none of it is the
subject.
direct: feeds proven working in the sibling Welcome to Your Galaxy repos.
Nothing invented — an untested feed URL reports itself unreachable on every
harvest and quietly makes the coverage figure a lie.
Like the science wire, this direct list is thin for the subject: the
sibling repos carry privacy and rights organisations, which cover the
tracking and neurotechnology half well, but nothing on studios, labels,
streaming economics or games. The events block and the additions below are
what will make the industry half work.
gnews: Google News locale searches; the harvester builds the URL from
hl / gl / ceid. Twenty-four queries rotate across 46 locales.
events: subject searches for regulators, courts, unions and research.
standing is provenance, not importance:
official  competition and data regulators, courts, classification bodies
research  concentration, algorithm and screen-time research
press     general news across the locales
rights    unions, privacy and audience organisations
Add next, with URLs you have opened: the Neurorights Foundation, noyb, the
Center for Humane Technology, Fairness for Musicians / United Musicians,
SAG-AFTRA and WGA newsrooms, Game Workers Unite, the Electronic Frontier
Foundation's Deeplinks, and national classification boards.
